submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One complete landscape conscription game interface, approximately21:9.
Primary request: Original “征兵” screen showing a coherent insufficient-resource preview for 第一部队, continuing our formation screen.
Reference hierarchy: Images1 and2 are the PRIMARY hand-painted Daoist jade/ivory/gold UI style. Image3 external screenshot is ONLY source for the existence of army formation and a conscription entry, not a conscription screen and not a style source. Image4 is our formation screen: preserve the same two general identities, card art cues and current troops (each500/1000). Do not use dark realistic war skin from image3.
Screen structure: Rounded jade-and-gold cloud frame, opaque ivory parchment main surface, narrow bright jade-roof training courtyard background at edges. Title “征兵” centered top, top-left back arrow, round X top-right. Under title subtitle “第一部队”. Top-right slim resource line “粮草 8000” and “铜钱 5000”.
Left60% has two spacious general recruitment cards side-by-side. Right35% is cost/status summary. Use readable large Chinese, clean alignment, small ornamental corners only.
Card1 heading “大营”; portrait from image4 is cheerful brown-haired 云游策士 with colorful Daoist hat, scroll and gourd. Name “云游策士”. Below exact rows “当前兵力 500 / 1000”, then slider label “目标兵力 1000”. Draw slider track with left endpoint “500”, right endpoint “1000”, jade handle at RIGHT endpoint. Then “新增兵力 +500”.
Card2 heading “中军”; portrait from image4 black-haired red/cream-robed 灵符法师 holding talisman, matching identity and face. Name “灵符法师”. Same exact numeric rows: “当前兵力 500 / 1000”, “目标兵力 1000”; slider minimum500 maximum1000 and handle at RIGHT; “新增兵力 +500”.
Below both cards, slim total preview strip “当前 1000” arrow “目标 2000” and “本次新增 1000”. Values sum exactly.
Right pane header “征兵消耗”. Two aligned cost rows with icon, required amount, owned amount:
“粮草”  “需要 10000”  “持有 8000”; required text red, explicit small red warning “不足 2000”.
“铜钱”  “需要 2000”  “持有 5000”; sufficient green check.
Then hourglass row “预计时间 00:20:00”.
Below divider, smaller section “预备役”. Empty UNCHECKED checkbox beside “使用预备役”; keep it off. Exact rows “可用 200” and “立即补满需 1000”. Small muted warning “预备役不足”. This is a separate unavailable instant refill option; no reserve has been spent and no resource deduction has occurred.
Bottom-right action is clearly DISABLED: pale gray-beige button with small lock icon and text “粮草不足”. It must NOT be vivid jade-green or look clickable. Beneath/near it a small short red message “请降低目标兵力或补充粮草”. Bottom-left ivory active secondary “返回配置”. Use green for editable sliders and resource-sufficient indicator, but not disabled confirm.
Demo state only, no claim of official game costs or formulas. No troop recruitment has begun. Do not mix a progress countdown with preview time, do not mark successful. Preserve the exact arithmetic and disabled state.
Style: exquisite Daoist Q/chibi hand-painted HD, ivory paper surfaces, jade controls, warm gold thin borders and rounded cloud motifs, dark-green readable Chinese, distinct soft cheerful chibi faces. Bright clean background with small lanterns. No gray-black realistic interface, no plastic shine, no overlong paragraphs, no watermark, no official game logo, no clipped controls. Opaque full screen.
